title: Ongoing arrangement with pilots of the black triangles, plus derivative US version

tellings.quote: that there is an exchange or some sort of arrangement with whatever is piloting the

plain: The US government may have an ongoing deal with whoever flies the black triangles, the large dark triangular craft reported in many UFO sightings, and may have built its own copy of them. A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown tells Michels he believes "there is an exchange or some sort of arrangement with whatever is piloting" them. If true, the government would be in contact with the pilots, not just watching their craft.
